tours.title: Is it touching?
tours.description: Check whether a sprite touches something.

steps.title: Touching
steps.text: This block is true when your sprite touches the mouse pointer, the edge, or another sprite. Put it in the condition of an “if” block.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when green flag clicked” block and an “if” block to your code area. Drag “touching mouse-pointer?” into the “if” condition, then click the green flag.

waitFor.label: Drag the “touching” block into the “if” condition

tours.title: Ask and answer
tours.description: Ask a question and use what someone types.

steps.title: Ask
steps.text: This block shows a question and waits for someone to type an answer.

steps.title: The answer
steps.text: This block holds whatever was typed in the last “ask” block. Use it anywhere a value fits.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added “ask” and “say” blocks to your code area. Drag “answer” into the “say” box, then click the green flag and type something.

waitFor.label: Drag the “answer” block into the “say” block
